name: memory-engine
description: Rust learning engine kernel and local beta study applications.

scripts.perf:actions: cargo run -p memory-engine-qa -- latency --backend file --iterations 5 --out target/perf/action-latency-file.json --markdown target/perf/action-latency-file.md && cargo run -p memory-engine-qa -- diff --base docs/perf/baselines/action-latency-file.v1.json --head target/perf/action-latency-file.json --budget docs/perf/action-latency-budgets.v1.json
scripts.perf:actions:postgres: if [ -n "$MEMORY_ENGINE_POSTGRES_TEST_URL" ]; then cargo run -p memory-engine-qa -- latency --backend postgres --iterations 5 --out target/perf/action-latency-postgres.json --markdown target/perf/action-latency-postgres.md; else echo 'MEMORY_ENGINE_POSTGRES_TEST_URL is unset; skipping Postgres action latency suite'; fi
scripts.rust:dogfood: cargo run -p memory-engine-cli && cargo run -p memory-engine-import && cargo run -p memory-engine-web-shell -- --receipt
scripts.rust:ci: bun run test:browser-contract && cargo fmt --all --check && cargo test --workspace && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo doc --workspace --no-deps && bun run perf:actions
